name: Before / After Image Slider
summary: Layered before-and-after comparison presentation whose control mechanics and position state remain target-owned.

anatomy.name: handle
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned comparison control or visual divider.

anatomy.name: handleKnob
anatomy.description: Generated visual knob for the optional divider.

anatomy.name: handleGlyph
anatomy.description: Generated bidirectional visual cue; it is not an accessible name.

anatomy.name: beforeLabel
anatomy.description: Visible label for the base image.

anatomy.name: afterLabel
anatomy.description: Visible label for the clipped image.

states.name: default
states.description: Static midpoint presentation supplied by canonical CSS.

states.name: controlFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus when a target renders the divider as a focusable control.

behavior.name: comparisonMechanicsBoundary
behavior.description: Canonical CSS supplies a static 50 percent clip and divider. This contract does not choose pointer dragging, keyboard semantics, range values, gesture handling, or state synchronization; those require a separate accepted behavior decision.

behavior.name: mediaSemantics
behavior.description: Targets provide useful alternative text or a shared accessible comparison description without duplicating confusing image announcements.

properties.name: afterMedia
properties.description: Target-owned image rendered in the clipped overlay layer.

properties.name: beforeLabel
properties.description: Optional visible label for the base image.

properties.name: afterLabel
properties.description: Optional visible label for the clipped image.

properties.name: control
properties.description: Optional target-owned control or divider content; no drag or range behavior is implied.

accessibility: Provide a concise shared comparison description or distinct useful alternatives without announcing redundant image content.
Visible before and after labels identify the compared states and do not rely on position alone.
Do not expose the visual divider as an interactive slider until keyboard operation, value bounds, current value, pointer behavior, focus, and announcements are defined.
If a target supplies a focusable control, it uses a touch-sized target and visible focus indicator.
